scenicChapters.title: Greece Pelion Peninsula Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 26.8%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Greece Pelion Peninsula Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: 1200 m come off over 11 km at around 8.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

greece-pelion-peninsula-loop.story: Out of Volos and back again: 47 km, roughly 45 min in the saddle. On the way it passes Makrinitsa, Chania Pelion, Tsagarada and Milies. The highest point is about 1,200 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
